title: Certain real surfaces in $\mathbb{C}^2$ with degenerated CR singularities
summary: In this paper, we study the local polynomial convexity of certain smooth real surfaces in \(\mathbb{C}^2\) with isolated CR singularity at the origin with higher-order of degeneracy. Under the assumption that the surface can be pulled back to a union of finitely many pairwise transverse totally real surfaces by a proper holomorphic map from $\mathbb{C}^2$ to $\mathbb{C}^2$, we obtain a normal form for such surfaces near the origin as $\{(z,w)\in\mathbb{C}^2: w= \overline{z}^k+o(|z|^{k})\}$ or $M_t := \left\{ (z,w)\in\mathbb{C}^2 : w=(z+t\overline{z})^k+o(|z|^k) \right\}$, for some \(t>0\),…
